content.text: Tillie moves into the old barn’s harness-room after Schwitter turns their home into a profitable road-house; she later has a baby and marries him. Christine visits Tillie with K., then confesses love to K., who remains devoted to Sidney. Sidney enters the hospital operating-room, becomes engaged to Dr. Wilson, but rejects him after learning of his affair with Carlotta. Joe mistakenly shoots Wilson at Schwitter’s, and K., revealed as surgeon Edwardes, saves him. K. helps Joe flee, assists Johnny Rosenfeld, and ultimately wins Sidney’s love. Carlotta confesses sabotaging surgical sponge counts. Meanwhile, Frank Merriwell’s adventures carry him through Mexico, New Orleans, and Florida: he rescues Inza, confronts criminals, saves Elsie Bellwood, survives the serpent vine, and exposes the “phantom” canoe as an electrical invention. In the Smoky Mountains, Frank and Barney rescue Kate Kenyon from a rock, but Kate’s jealous suitor Wade Miller threatens them.
